text:
```yaml
name: Scripts Android

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: macos-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up JDK 8
      uses: actions/setup-java@v2
      with:
        java-version: '8'
        distribution: 'adopt'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        brew update
        brew install maven

    - name: Configure environment
      run: source tools/env.sh

    - name: Build Android port
      run: ./scripts/build-android-port.sh -q -DskipTests

    - name: Lint YAML files
      run: yamllint .github/workflows/scripts-android.yml .github/workflows/scripts-ios.yml

    - name: Check shell scripts
      uses: luizm/action-sh-checker@883217215b11c1fabbf00eb1a9a041f62d74c744
      with:
        sh_checker_exclude: "**/.git/**,**/node_modules/**"
        sh_checker_shellcheck_disable: true
        sh_checker_comment: "Shellcheck and shfmt have been disabled for this workflow."

    - name: Test setup workspace
      run: ./scripts/setup-workspace.sh -q -DskipTests
      env:
        SKIP_ARCHETYPES: true
        SKIP_JAVADOC: true
```
